title: Sign products under coordinate identification
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $\pi:\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\mathrm{Fin}\,m$, let $S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, and let $w\in\{0,1\}^m$. The product of the sign encodings of $w(\pi(i))$ over $i\in S$ equals the product of the sign encodings of $w(j)$ over those $j\in\mathrm{Fin}\,m$ whose fibers in $S$ have odd cardinality.
replaced:
For $n,m\in\mathbb N$, a map $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$, $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and $w\in\{0,1\}^{m}$, set $O_{\pi}(S)=\{j\in\{1,\ldots,m\}:|\{i\in S:\pi(i)=j\}|\text{ is odd}\}$; then
\[
\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{w_{\pi(i)}}=\prod_{j\in O_{\pi}(S)}(-1)^{w_j}.
\]
